infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Persistence needs access to your health data to track your fitness progress, including steps, workouts, and activity levels.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Persistence saves the weigh-ins and sleep you log in the app to Health, so your other apps stay in sync. Nothing is written unless you log it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Persistence needs access to your photos so you can choose a profile picture, snap a photo of your meals for AI food logging, or use a photo of your gym so Loadout can read the equipment.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Persistence uses the camera to scan food barcodes, take a profile picture, snap photos of your meals for AI food logging, and photograph your gym so Loadout can read the equipment.
